exposure: early ambulation after 6 hours post-caesarean section
remaining supine for 12 hours post-caesarean section
cohort: 140 women undergoing elective caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Early ambulation significantly reduced the incidence, severity, and delayed the onset of post-dural puncture headache, and was associated with shorter hospital stays and fewer complications in cesarean section patients.
mod_finding: Early ambulation after caesarean section significantly reduces the incidence and severity of post-dural puncture headache, shortens hospital stays, and reduces postoperative complications.
